highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews the Skia m154 engine update.
highlights_body: This release advances the bundled renderer to the next Chrome milestone without changing the managed API surface.

bullets.detail: Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 154 while preserving SkiaSharp's managed API surface.
